# algebra.library: Subtract

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The position displaced by the negation of delta. The `-` spelling of
> Add(x, -delta).

## Signature

```plato
Subtract(x: IDifference<$D>, delta: $D): IDifference<$D>
Subtract(a: IDifference<$D>, b: IDifference<$D>): $D
```

### Law_AddThenSubtractDeltaIsIdentity2D

[stdlib/tests/foundation.laws.plato, line 145](../../../../../stdlib/tests/foundation.laws.plato#L145)

```plato
// Displacing by a delta and back is the identity: (p + d) - d == p. Exercises the
// derived Subtract(position, delta), which routes through Negative on the delta.
Law_AddThenSubtractDeltaIsIdentity2D(p: Point2D, d: Vector2D): Boolean
    => p.Add(d).Subtract(d).Distance(p) <= 1e-4;
```

### Law_SubstringCountIsTheClampedRange

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 54](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L54)

```plato
// The length is the size of the intersection of [start, start + count) with [0, Count).
Law_SubstringCountIsTheClampedRange(s: String, start: Integer, count: Integer): Boolean
    => Substring(s, start, count).Count
        == (count <= 0 ? 0 : (start + count).Min(s.Count).Subtract(start.Max(0)).Max(0));
```

### Line 56

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/algebra.library.plato, line 56](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/algebra.library.plato#L56).

```plato

    //==
    // IDifference<TDelta> — the affine surface, derived
    //
    // `IDifference` declares only Add(Self, TDelta) and Between(Self, Self): the
    // torsor action and its inverse. Everything below follows from those two plus
    // the interface's `where TDelta: IAdditive, TDelta: IScalable` bound, so an
    // implementing type owes two members rather than the six it used to spell out
    // by hand. Point2D/Point3D and Instant previously wrote all of this per type
    // (transforms.library.plato, time.library.plato); PointN, UvCoordinate
    // and UvwCoordinate declared `implements IDifference<...>` and wrote none of
    // it, so they carried throwing stubs until these bodies existed.
    //
    // The earlier note here said Plato had no type-parameter constraint syntax and
    // that MidPoint was therefore unreachable. That was already out of date:
    // `where` clauses on interfaces are live (IInterval / IBounds in
    // intervals-bounds.concepts.plato), and MidPoint now falls out of the Lerp
    // below via IInterpolatable.

    // The position displaced by the negation of delta. The `-` spelling of
    // Add(x, -delta).
    Subtract(x: IDifference<$D>, delta: $D): IDifference<$D>
        => x.Add(delta.Negative);
```

### Line 79

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/algebra.library.plato, line 79](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/algebra.library.plato#L79).

```plato

    // The displacement from b to a (a - b). Same delta as Between(b, a); the `-`
    // operator spelling of position difference. Orientation follows Between.
    Subtract(a: IDifference<$D>, b: IDifference<$D>): $D
        => b.Between(a);
```
